verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents an accuracy guarantee, a reimbursement commitment, or audit support if an Anrok calculation proves wrong. The closest item says Anrok recalculates and verifies Shopify's calculations 'to ensure accuracy', which is an adjacent accuracy feature rather than a commitment to stand behind its numbers. Managed filing is likewise not an audit-defense commitment.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the vendor stands behind its numbers — a documented accuracy guarantee or audit support commitment if a calculation it produced turns out wrong
